answer: In this PoA model, reputation is assigned on a reciprocity-weighted trust graph and multiplied by exponential temporal decay with a fixed half-life, making sustained honest service necessary for durable influence. A freshly spawned sybil identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming edges and transitive support, so it cannot pass consensus thresholds. Each delta update traverses the endorsement trellis, while glacier-slow accumulation prevents instant authority.
